.. py:function:: get_few_models_for_debugging(random_state: int | None = 42) -> dict[str, ModelConfigDict]

   Build conservative model configs for small-n regression.

   Designed for small datasets, e.g. n ≈ 80, where overfitting risk is high.

.. py:function:: get_model_configs_more_complex_models(random_state: int | None = 42) -> dict[str, ModelConfigDict]

   Build model pipelines and hyperparameter grids used in evaluation.

   :param random_state: Random seed used by stochastic models.
   :type random_state: int | None, optional

   :returns: Mapping from model name to pipeline and parameter grid.
   :rtype: dict[str, ModelConfigDict]
